title: Intracranial current source density (CSD) during epileptic seizures and interictal periods, one patient (Budapest)
description: This derivative iEEG dataset provides current source density (CSD) traces computed by the data authors from subdural ECoG recorded in a single patient with drug-resistant epilepsy at the Budapest epilepsy center. It contains 18 seizure segments and 16 interictal segments, each with 20480 samples across four channels. No raw ECoG is included in the release, and the units of the CSD values are not specified by the source. The data were used to demonstrate causal inference between dynamical systems.
methods_description: A 20-year-old patient with drug-resistant epilepsy was implanted with subdural grids and strips (ADTECH, 10 mm inter-contact spacing) for pre-surgical evaluation. Video-EEG was recorded with a Micromed Brain-Quick System Evolution at 1024 Hz. CSD was computed by the data authors at fronto-lateral, inferior-parietal and fronto-basal sites.
